summary: Quiet cul-de-sac kerb under trees; homes 12-25 m away all round.
reasons: Cars park near the turning head

best_section.where: south kerb near the Brinkworth Place turning head

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 21-27 m near the head, garage 15 m; tree screening on the south side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; cars stand near the head so there is room, but the road is narrow and treed.
drivers.convention: Cars park at the head; no signs mapped.

flags: Brisbane River 307 m away, elevation about 7 m
